title: Connection Terminated
blurb: "Connection terminated. I'm sorry to interrupt you, Elizabeth..." So begins William Afton's monologue in Sister Location, delivered in a calm, fatherly register that makes it considerably worse. It is the most quoted piece of dialogue in the entire franchise, remixed endlessly into edits and intros. It also marks the moment FNAF stopped being scattered newspaper clippings and started being a story about a father and his daughter. Play it to cut somebody off mid-sentence with maximum theatre. Apologise first, obviously. Afton always does.
origin: William Afton's line from Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location (2016).
